text.title: Product Launch Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable inputs to a rule from `01-core-rules.xml`. MANDATORY for every methodology — even flat ones — per F-066 DoD.

decision-tree.root-question: Do all Applies-If preconditions hold AND no Skip-If disqualifier is true?

branch.question: Are required inputs present AND aligned with the rubric?

branch.when: required_inputs_present == true AND r1_stage_gates_check == true AND launch_type_chosen == false
required_inputs_present == true AND r1_stage_gates_check == true AND launch_type_chosen == true AND launch_date_locked == false
required_inputs_present == true AND r1_stage_gates_check == true AND launch_type_chosen == true AND launch_date_locked == true AND five_assets_owned == false
required_inputs_present == true AND r1_stage_gates_check == true AND launch_type_chosen == true AND launch_date_locked == true AND five_assets_owned == true

text.example: All preconditions satisfied, launch type chosen, date locked, five assets owned → conclusion r3-rollback-precondition; no launch type chosen → r9-launch-type-first.
